Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience in test automation and quality engineering. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Python , Robot Framework and/or Playwright , with a strong background in designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks for web applications and APIs. This role requires a quality-focused professional who can collaborate effectively with global teams and contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices and processes.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks using Python , Robot Framework , and/or Playwright .
Create, execute, and maintain automated test suites for web applications, APIs, and end-to-end business processes.
Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure high product quality.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing initiatives.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and work closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution.
Participate in requirement reviews and provide quality-focused feedback throughout the software development lifecycle.
Develop reusable test components and promote automation best practices across the team.
Perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot complex automation and application issues.
Contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Continuously improve test coverage, automation efficiency, and overall software quality.
 Minimum Requirements 
Fluency in English;
5+ years of experience in test automation engineering .
Strong proficiency in Python programming and scripting .
Hands-on experience with Robot Framework and/or Playwright .
Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of web application and API testing.
Experience with CI/CD tools and automated test execution.
Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools.
Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
 What do we offer? 
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform (possibility of choosing flexible benefits like meal tickets, medical coverage for employees and dependents at Regina Maria, private pension, sport subscription, etc.)
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
Eyeglasses cost reimbursement: 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
